subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should OpenClaw add a validated host-path remapping contract for Docker Gateway/DooD sandbox managed mounts, or keep the current identical host/container path requirement as the supported contract?
rationale: The choice changes sandbox bind-source trust boundaries, operator setup compatibility, config/schema or doctor needs, and future browser/materialized-skill mount behavior, so automation should not choose it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define Secure Remapping Contract
options.body: Add or sponsor validated mapping for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, and browser mounts, with docs/schema/doctor coverage as needed and live DooD proof.

options.title: Keep Identical-Path Contract
options.body: Document and diagnose that Docker Gateway deployments must mount the same host path inside the Gateway container, instead of translating paths automatically.

options.title: Land Only Narrow Skill Repair
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94057 or a replacement as a partial materialized-skill fix while leaving this broader workspaceAccess issue open.

recommendation.title: Define Secure Remapping Contract
recommendation.body: Add or sponsor validated mapping for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, and browser mounts, with docs/schema/doctor coverage as needed and live DooD proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They already marked this item as the canonical cluster and are the strongest current maintainer signal for the host-path contract decision.
